plugins.microphonePermission: Gear World uses the microphone only when you tap the microphone button, to turn what you say into a product search. The app does not keep any recordings.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Gear World uses speech recognition to turn what you say into a product search. The app does not keep any recordings.

plugins.photosPermission: Gear World uses a photo only when you choose one, to find similar products. The photo is made smaller on your phone, sent once to search and not saved.
plugins.cameraPermission: Gear World uses the camera only when you tap the camera button, to take a photo of a product and search for it. The photo is not saved.
